subject: prd/prd-review
statement: When a review round completes, the reviewer shall record exactly one verdict — approve · approve-with-advisories · request-changes · escalate — where request-changes requires ≥ 1 blocking finding, and the report (findings, dispositions, rounds, verdict history, measurements) shall ride the document's introducing PR as its evidence package.
rationale: the total verdict set is the protocol's spine (— #D-2); the report is J5's audit surface
fit_criterion: every fixture run ends with exactly one verdict; reports parse against the artifact schema; the evidence package is present on the PR in the e2e demo
